newsitem.title: USA: DuPont's stock falls on Conoco spinoff rumors.
newsitem.headline: DuPont's stock falls on Conoco spinoff rumors.

text.p: DuPont Co.'s stock fell Wednesday on market talk that the company would not spin off its Conoco energy unit, traders said.
The chemical company's stock fell $2.25 to $93 in afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange, where it was one of the most heavily traded issues.
A spokeswoman for DuPont, based in Wilmington, Del., declined to comment on the company's stock activity or the market speculation, citing corporate policy.
She did, however, deny a rumour that the company was planning a conference call with Wall Street analysts.

Traders have speculated on a Conoco spinoff after the company said in June it was restructuring the business and had been in talks with Phillips Petroleum Co. on combining refining, marketing and transportation operations.
